The words of a blueprint, a case for each: a text written with the word any
old way, that text as it is laid out, the word written wrongly, and where
and why the reader refuses that. `WRITE_WORDS=1` on the test that reads
this writes what is laid out and what is refused, to be read before it is
kept.

=== blueprint.blueprint
--- written
blueprint:   w
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
--- laid
blueprint: w

steps:
  a: { do: noop }
--- wrong
blueprint: [w]
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
--- refused 1:12
`blueprint` must be text, found a list

=== blueprint.description
--- written
blueprint: w
description:    What it is for.
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
--- laid
blueprint: w
description: What it is for.

steps:
  a: { do: noop }
--- wrong
blueprint: w
description: [a]
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
--- refused 2:14
`description` must be text, found a list

=== blueprint.durable
--- written
blueprint: w
durable: false
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
--- laid
blueprint: w
durable: false

steps:
  a: { do: noop }
--- wrong
blueprint: w
durable: sometimes
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
--- refused 2:10
`durable` must be true or false

=== blueprint.env
--- written
blueprint: w
env: {REGION: eu}
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
--- laid
blueprint: w
env: { REGION: eu }

steps:
  a: { do: noop }
--- wrong
blueprint: w
env: [a]
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
--- refused 2:6
`env` must be a mapping, found a list

=== blueprint.max_parallel
--- written
blueprint: w
max_parallel: 2
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
--- laid
blueprint: w
max_parallel: 2

steps:
  a: { do: noop }
--- wrong
blueprint: w
max_parallel: many
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
--- refused 2:15
`max_parallel` must be a whole number, 1 or more

=== blueprint.on
--- written
blueprint: w
on:
    poke: {event: w.poke, do: noop}
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
--- laid
blueprint: w

on:
  poke: { event: w.poke, do: noop }

steps:
  a: { do: noop }
--- wrong
blueprint: w
on: [a]
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
--- refused 2:5
`on` must be a mapping of handler name to handler

=== blueprint.on_fail
--- written
blueprint: w
on_fail:
    - {do: noop}
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
--- laid
blueprint: w

on_fail:
  - { do: noop }

steps:
  a: { do: noop }
--- wrong
blueprint: w
on_fail: 3
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
--- refused 2:10
a hook must be a mapping, found a number

=== blueprint.one_at_a_time
--- written
blueprint: w
one_at_a_time: true
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
--- laid
blueprint: w
one_at_a_time: true

steps:
  a: { do: noop }
--- wrong
blueprint: w
one_at_a_time: maybe
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
--- refused 2:16
`one_at_a_time` must be true or false

=== blueprint.outputs
--- written
blueprint: w
outputs: {v: 1}
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
--- laid
blueprint: w
outputs: { v: 1 }

steps:
  a: { do: noop }
--- wrong
blueprint: w
outputs: [a]
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
--- refused 2:10
`outputs` must be a mapping, found a list

=== blueprint.params
--- written
blueprint: w
params:
    who: {type: string, default: me}
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
--- laid
blueprint: w

params:
  who: { type: string, default: me }

steps:
  a: { do: noop }
--- wrong
blueprint: w
params: [a]
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
--- refused 2:9
`params` must be a mapping of name to default or spec

=== blueprint.permissions
--- written
blueprint: w
permissions: [shell]
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
--- laid
blueprint: w
permissions: [shell]

steps:
  a: { do: noop }
--- wrong
blueprint: w
permissions: 3
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
--- refused 2:14
`permissions` must be a list of names

steps:
  a: { do: noop }
--- wrong
blueprint: w
state: [a]
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
--- refused 2:8
`state` must be a mapping, found a list

=== blueprint.steps
--- written
blueprint: w
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
    b: {do: noop}
--- laid
blueprint: w

steps:
  a: { do: noop }
  b: { do: noop }
--- wrong
blueprint: w
steps: [a]
--- refused 2:8
`steps` must be a mapping of step name to step

=== blueprint.uses
--- written
blueprint: w
uses:
    other: {blueprint: other}
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
--- laid
blueprint: w

uses:
  other: { blueprint: other }

steps:
  a: { do: noop }
--- wrong
blueprint: w
uses: 3
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
--- refused 2:7
`uses` must be a mapping of name to blueprint

=== blueprint.version
--- written
blueprint: w
version: 2
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
--- laid
blueprint: w
version: 2

steps:
  a: { do: noop }
--- wrong
blueprint: w
version: [1]
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
--- refused 2:10
`version` must be text, found a list
